types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Animation.VoltAnimator
types.doc: An animator on a world object.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Animation.VoltAnimatorState
types.doc: What an animator layer is doing.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Audio.VoltAudioClip
types.doc: A sound that is part of the world. Scripts cannot load sound from files or the web.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Audio.VoltAudioMixer
types.doc: A mixer that is part of the world.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Audio.VoltAudioSource
types.doc: Something in the world that plays sound.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Cameras.VoltCamera
types.doc: A camera that belongs to the world, for mirrors, screens and security monitors. Scripts never get the camera a player sees through, and a world camera cannot render to a player's display.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Contract.VoltCompilerServices
types.doc: Helpers the VoltCS compiler calls for language features that need the runtime. Scripts never name these; the compiler emits them, and they are part of the API contract like everything else a module can call.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltData
types.doc: Structured data with named values, the shape of a JSON object. Use it for web requests, storage and anything that needs more than a flat list of fields.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltDataList
types.doc: A list of data tokens.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltDataToken
types.doc: One value of structured data: nothing, a bool, a number, text, a list or an object.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltDataType
types.doc: What a data token holds.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltDictionary<TKey, TValue>
types.doc: A table that finds a value by its key. Keys can be numbers, strings, bools, characters and enums.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltJson
types.doc: Converts between structured data and JSON text. Input is limited to one megabyte and 32 levels of nesting.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Data.VoltList<T>
types.doc: A resizable list. Every list counts toward the world's script memory, and a list cannot grow beyond one million items.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Economy.VoltEconomy
types.doc: The products of this world. A script can ask what the local player owns and can ask ParelVR to offer a purchase; ParelVR shows its own confirmation and handles the payment. A script can never complete a purchase by itself and never sees another player's purchases.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Economy.VoltProduct
types.doc: Something this world sells. A script sees what the player sees in the shop, never payment details.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Input.VoltInput
types.doc: The local player's input as actions. Scripts never see keys, buttons, devices or anything typed into a text field, and input is not reported while a ParelVR menu is open.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Input.VoltInputAction
types.doc: An action a player can perform, whatever device they use for it.

values.name: Movement
values.doc: Walking: an axis pair read with GetAxis2D.

values.name: Turn
values.doc: Turning: an axis pair read with GetAxis2D.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Input.VoltVRInput
types.doc: Input that only exists in VR.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Instance.VoltInstance
types.doc: The running copy of the world that the local player is in.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Instance.VoltInstancePrivacy
types.doc: Who can join an instance.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Interaction.VoltHand
types.doc: Which hand holds something.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Interaction.VoltInteractable
types.doc: Makes an object usable: players see a prompt when they point at it and the behaviours on the object get OnInteract when they use it.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Interaction.VoltPickup
types.doc: Makes an object something players can pick up and carry. Add a VoltObjectSync as well so everyone sees where it goes.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Interaction.VoltStation
types.doc: A seat. A player who uses it sits at the station's position until they leave.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Interaction.VoltStationMobility
types.doc: How a player can leave a station.

values.name: Immobilize
values.doc: The player cannot move while seated and leaves by moving or jumping.

values.name: ImmobilizeForVehicle
values.doc: The player stays seated until a script calls ExitStation.

values.name: Mobile
values.doc: The player can walk while attached to the station.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Networking.VoltNetworkTarget
types.doc: Who receives a network event.

values.name: All
values.doc: Everyone in the instance, the sender included.

values.name: Others
values.doc: Everyone except the sender.

values.name: Owner
values.doc: The player who owns the object.

values.name: Master
values.doc: The instance master.

values.name: Authority
values.doc: The player with authority over the object: its owner, or the master when it has none.

values.name: Local
values.doc: Only this client; nothing is sent.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Networking.VoltNetworking
types.doc: The state of the connection to other players, and ownership of world objects.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Networking.VoltObjectSync
types.doc: Keeps the position and rotation of an object the same for every player. The owner's copy decides; the others follow it smoothly. Add it to anything players can move: pickups, physics props, doors on hinges.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltCollider
types.doc: A collider of any shape.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltComponent
types.doc: Base of the references to components.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltForceMode
types.doc: How a force is applied to a rigidbody.

values.name: Force
values.doc: A continuous force that takes mass into account.

values.name: Impulse
values.doc: An instant push that takes mass into account.

values.name: VelocityChange
values.doc: An instant change of velocity that ignores mass.

values.name: Acceleration
values.doc: A continuous acceleration that ignores mass.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltGameObject
types.doc: An object in the world scene.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltLight
types.doc: A light.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltObject
types.doc: Base of the references a script can hold to things in the world scene. A reference only ever points at an object that belongs to the world; anything else reads as null.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltObjectReference
types.doc: The stable id of a scene object. It is the same for every player and survives a rebuild of the world, so it is what to put in synced fields, network events and storage when a script needs to name an object.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltRenderer
types.doc: Something that draws: a mesh, a skinned mesh, a line, a trail.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltRigidbody
types.doc: A physics body.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltSceneComponent
types.doc: Base of the components ParelVR adds to Unity for worlds, such as VoltPickup and VoltStation. A script can hold one in a field and assign it in the inspector like any other component.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Objects.VoltTransform
types.doc: Position, rotation and scale of an object, and its place in the hierarchy.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Particles.VoltParticleSystem
types.doc: A particle system on a world object.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Physics.VoltCollision
types.doc: Details of a collision.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Physics.VoltPhysics
types.doc: Queries against the world's colliders. A query can hit a player, but it never hands a script anything that belongs to ParelVR itself: such hits report a point and a distance and nothing else.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Physics.VoltRaycastHit
types.doc: What a ray or a shape cast hit.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Players.VoltBone
types.doc: A bone of a player's avatar.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Players.VoltPlayer
types.doc: A player in the current instance. A script only ever sees what ParelVR chooses to share about a player: never an account, a session or anything that identifies the device.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Players.VoltTrackingPoint
types.doc: A point on a player's body that ParelVR tracks or estimates.

values.name: Origin
values.doc: The floor point under the player: where the avatar stands.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Scene.VoltScene
types.doc: The objects of the world scene.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Storage.VoltStorage
types.doc: Data that outlives the session, kept by ParelVR's own backend. Keys are up to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores; values are text up to 64 KB. A script can only reach the local player's data.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Storage.VoltStorageRequest
types.doc: A storage request in progress. Yield it in a coroutine to wait for the result, or override OnStorageResult on the behaviour that started it.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Storage.VoltStorageScope
types.doc: Whose data a storage key belongs to.

values.name: World
values.doc: One value for the whole world, shared by every visitor in every instance.

values.name: Player
values.doc: The local player's data, shared by every world of the same creator.

values.name: PlayerWorld
values.doc: The local player's data in this world only.

values.name: Instance
values.doc: Data of this instance. It is gone when the instance closes.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltButton
types.doc: A button. Wire its click to a behaviour's public method in the inspector.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltCanvas
types.doc: A canvas in the world.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltImage
types.doc: A picture element.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltInputField
types.doc: A text box players can type into.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltPanel
types.doc: A rectangle of the UI: the layout of anything on a canvas.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltScrollView
types.doc: A scrolling area.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltSlider
types.doc: A slider.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltText
types.doc: A text element, legacy or TextMeshPro.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltToggle
types.doc: A checkbox.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.UI.VoltUI
types.doc: Helpers for world UI.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Video.VoltVideoError
types.doc: Why a video failed.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Video.VoltVideoPlayer
types.doc: A video screen in the world. It plays from an https address through ParelVR's own video pipeline, which applies the same address rules as web requests.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltBehaviour
types.doc: Base class of every world script. A class that derives from it is compiled by the VoltCS compiler into Volt bytecode and run by VoltVM inside ParelVR; Unity never runs its code. Override the On... methods to receive events, and mark fields with VoltSynced to share them with other players.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltCoroutine
types.doc: A running coroutine. Coroutines are state machines inside VoltVM: they never run on another thread, and a world can have at most 512 of them at a time.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltDebug
types.doc: Messages for the creator. They go to the Volt Console in the editor and to the world log in ParelVR.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltError
types.doc: Why a web request, a storage request or a purchase did not succeed.

values.name: InvalidArgument
values.doc: The address or the key is not well formed.

values.name: NotPermitted
values.doc: The world is not allowed to do this, or the player has switched it off.

values.name: DomainNotAllowed
values.doc: The address is not on the world's list of allowed domains.

values.name: RateLimited
values.doc: Too many requests in a short time.

values.name: TooLarge
values.doc: The request or the answer is larger than the limit.

values.name: Timeout
values.doc: No answer arrived in time.

values.name: NetworkError
values.doc: The connection failed.

values.name: HttpError
values.doc: The server answered with an error status.

values.name: NotFound
values.doc: There is no value for the key.

values.name: Unavailable
values.doc: The service is not available right now.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltProfiler
types.doc: What the world's scripts cost, for scripts that want to adapt to it.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltRuntime
types.doc: Facts about the runtime a script is running in.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltTime
types.doc: Clocks.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltWait
types.doc: The waits a coroutine can yield. Yielding null waits for the next frame.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.VoltWaitInstruction
types.doc: What a coroutine yields to say when it wants to continue.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Web.VoltStringDownloader
types.doc: Loads text from the web. The same rules as VoltWeb apply.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Web.VoltUrl
types.doc: A web address. Only https addresses of public hosts are valid.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Web.VoltWeb
types.doc: Controlled access to the web. Requests are https only, go to hosts the world declared when it was built, are limited in number, size and time, and never carry anything that identifies the player.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Web.VoltWebRequest
types.doc: A web request in progress. Yield it in a coroutine to wait for the answer, or override OnWebResponse on the behaviour that started it.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Web.VoltWebResponse
types.doc: The answer to a web request.

types.name: ParelVR.Volt.Worlds.VoltWorld
types.doc: The world that is loaded and the players in it.

members.name: MemoryBytes
members.doc: Estimate of the memory the world's scripts hold, in bytes.

members.name: ScriptMsLastFrame
members.doc: Milliseconds every script of the world took in the last frame.

members.name: ApiVersion
members.doc: Version of the Volt API the runtime provides, such as "1.0".

members.name: BytecodeVersion
members.doc: Version of the bytecode format the runtime reads.

members.name: IsEditor
members.doc: True when the script runs in the Unity editor's simulator instead of ParelVR.

members.name: Platform
members.doc: The platform ParelVR runs on: "windows" or "android".

members.name: DeltaTime
members.doc: Seconds the last frame took.

members.name: FixedDeltaTime
members.doc: Seconds between physics steps.

members.name: FrameCount
members.doc: Frames since the world loaded.

members.name: LocalOffsetMinutes
members.doc: Difference between this device's local time and UTC in minutes.

members.name: RealTime
members.doc: Real seconds since the world loaded, whatever the time scale.

members.name: Time
members.doc: Seconds since the world loaded.

members.name: UnixTimeMilliseconds
members.doc: Milliseconds since 1 January 1970 UTC, from this device's clock.

members.name: UnixTimeSeconds
members.doc: Seconds since 1 January 1970 UTC, from this device's clock.

members.name: EndOfFrame
members.doc: Waits until the end of the frame.

members.name: FixedUpdate
members.doc: Waits for the next physics step.

members.name: Frames
members.doc: Waits a number of frames.

members.name: RealSeconds
members.doc: Waits a number of real seconds, whatever the world's time scale.

members.name: Seconds
members.doc: Waits a number of seconds of world time.

members.name: Until
members.doc: Waits until a method of this behaviour returns true. Checked once per frame.

members.name: While
members.doc: Waits while a method of this behaviour returns true. Checked once per frame.

members.name: Load
members.doc: Loads the text at an address.

members.name: VoltUrl
members.doc: Wraps an address. An address that is not valid can be created but is refused when it is used.

members.name: Host
members.doc: The host part of the address, in lower case.

members.name: IsValid
members.doc: True when the address is a plain https address of a public host.

members.name: Value
members.doc: The address as text.

members.name: Get
members.doc: Requests an address and returns at once; the answer arrives later.

members.name: IsAllowed
members.doc: True when the world may send requests to the address.

members.name: Post
members.doc: Sends text to an address.

members.name: PostJson
members.doc: Sends structured data to an address as JSON.

members.name: Error
members.doc: Why the request failed.

members.name: IsDone
members.doc: True once the request has finished, whatever the result.

members.name: Response
members.doc: The answer. Null until the request is done, and when no answer arrived.

members.name: Success
members.doc: True when an answer with a success status arrived.

members.name: Text
members.doc: The body of the answer as text, or an empty string.

members.name: Url
members.doc: The address that was requested.

members.name: ContentType
members.doc: The content type the server reported.

members.name: IsSuccess
members.doc: True for a status from 200 to 299.

members.name: StatusCode
members.doc: HTTP status code.

members.name: Text
members.doc: The body as text.

members.name: GetPlayer
members.doc: The player with a PlayerId, or null.

members.name: GetPlayers
members.doc: Every player in the instance.

members.name: RespawnPlayer
members.doc: Moves a player back to a spawn point. Only works for the local player.

members.name: ReturnToHub
members.doc: Asks ParelVR to take the local player back to their home world. ParelVR asks the player to confirm.

members.name: DeltaTime
members.doc: Seconds the last frame took.

members.name: FixedDeltaTime
members.doc: Seconds between physics steps.

members.name: LocalPlayer
members.doc: The player on this client.

members.name: PlayerCount
members.doc: Number of players in the instance.

members.name: Players
members.doc: Every player in the instance.

members.name: Time
members.doc: Seconds since the world loaded.

members.name: WorldId
members.doc: Id of this world.

members.name: WorldName
members.doc: Name of this world as shown in the menu.

members.name: WorldVersion
members.doc: Version of the world build that is running. It changes every time the creator publishes.

events.name: OnStart
events.doc: Called once, before the first OnUpdate, when the behaviour first becomes active.

events.name: OnUpdate
events.doc: Called every frame.

events.name: OnLateUpdate
events.doc: Called every frame after every OnUpdate.

events.name: OnFixedUpdate
events.doc: Called on every physics step.

events.name: OnEnabled
events.doc: Called when the behaviour becomes active.

events.name: OnDisabled
events.doc: Called when the behaviour stops being active.

events.name: OnDestroyed
events.doc: Called when the object is destroyed or the world unloads.

events.name: OnInteract
events.doc: The local player used this object. Needs a VoltInteractable or a collider on the object.

events.name: OnPickup
events.doc: The local player picked this object up. Needs a VoltPickup on the object.

events.name: OnDrop
events.doc: The local player let go of this object.

events.name: OnPickupUseDown
events.doc: The local player pressed Use while holding this object.

events.name: OnPickupUseUp
events.doc: The local player released Use while holding this object.

events.name: OnPlayerJoined
events.doc: A player joined the instance. Also called once for every player already present when the world loads.

events.name: OnPlayerLeft
events.doc: A player left the instance.

events.name: OnPlayerRespawned
events.doc: A player was moved back to a spawn point.

events.name: OnStationEntered
events.doc: A player sat down in the VoltStation on this object.

events.name: OnStationExited
events.doc: A player left the VoltStation on this object.

events.name: OnOwnershipTransferred
events.doc: Ownership of this object moved to another player.

events.name: OnOwnershipRequest
events.doc: Someone asks for ownership. Runs on the current owner; return false to refuse.

events.name: OnPreSerialization
events.doc: Called on the owner just before the synced fields are sent.

events.name: OnDeserialization
events.doc: Called after synced fields were received from the owner.

events.name: OnPostSerialization
events.doc: Called on the owner after the synced fields were sent, with the result and the size in bytes.

events.name: OnMasterChanged
events.doc: The instance master changed.

events.name: OnEnterTrigger
events.doc: A collider entered a trigger collider on this object.

events.name: OnExitTrigger
events.doc: A collider left a trigger collider on this object.

events.name: OnStayTrigger
events.doc: A collider is inside a trigger collider on this object. Called on every physics step.

events.name: OnEnterCollision
events.doc: Something hit a collider on this object.

events.name: OnExitCollision
events.doc: Something stopped touching a collider on this object.

events.name: OnPlayerEnterTrigger
events.doc: A player entered a trigger collider on this object.

events.name: OnPlayerExitTrigger
events.doc: A player left a trigger collider on this object.

events.name: OnPlayerStayTrigger
events.doc: A player is inside a trigger collider on this object. Called on every physics step.

events.name: OnPlayerEnterCollision
events.doc: A player bumped into a collider on this object.

events.name: OnPlayerExitCollision
events.doc: A player stopped touching a collider on this object.

events.name: OnWebResponse
events.doc: A web request this behaviour started has finished.

events.name: OnStorageResult
events.doc: A storage request this behaviour started has finished.

events.name: OnVideoReady
events.doc: A video is loaded and ready to play.

events.name: OnVideoStarted
events.doc: A video started playing.

events.name: OnVideoPaused
events.doc: A video was paused.

events.name: OnVideoEnded
events.doc: A video reached its end.

events.name: OnVideoError
events.doc: A video could not be loaded or played.

events.name: OnInputAction
events.doc: The local player pressed or released an input action.

events.name: OnPurchaseCompleted
events.doc: A purchase the local player started in this world went through or failed.
